requirements: Add bin/switch.js <branch>: switch the repository in the current directory to the named branch, using the existing runGit helper. Branch names are typed by users.

defects.consequence: runGit passes its arguments through a shell, so a user-typed branch name such as 'main; rm -rf ~' runs arbitrary commands.
defects.origin: Repository maintenance commands launch Git by bare name

decoys.consequence: switch.js exits with status 0 when no branch is given.
decoys.reason: A missing branch prints the usage line and exits with status 2.
